name: train-delay-predictor
description: RailPulse: Indian Railways train delay analysis, journey planner and forecasting (Python backend + Express + React).

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run setup:python && python3 main.py --regenerate
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run server" "npm run client"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm --prefix server start
